prompts.prompt: A plain blue ceramic mug slowly rotates on a turntable against a neutral gray background. Fixed camera, soft studio light.
An adult wearing a plain green shirt waves one hand while standing against a beige wall. Fixed medium shot in daylight.

prompt_source.description: repository/path are the frozen pilot driver's public VBench registry (only origin=='vbench' prompts are looked up there; none here). The 64 prompts come from prompts/univ_controlled_factor_dev2.jsonl, authored 2026-10-20 after the v1/v2a analyses, disjoint from all 20 controlled-factor families including the locked test. Nominal motion/detail labels are design annotations, not measured facts.

prompts.prompt: A single large plain white paper crane sits motionless on an empty light gray table. The locked camera frames its broad smooth folds, there are no patterns or other objects, and the soft even lighting never changes.

A locked camera looks down at hundreds of tiny folded paper cranes covered in fine printed floral patterns, thin creases, and sharp pointed wings, strung on delicate threads. Every crane hangs completely still under steady studio light, filling the frame with crisp detail.

One large plain white paper crane is tossed by a strong gust and tumbles rapidly across an empty light gray table, flipping and spinning with big frame-to-frame displacement. The background is uniform and the camera stays fixed.

Hundreds of tiny patterned paper cranes swirl rapidly through the air in front of a fixed camera, their thin creased wings and printed floral details crossing and occluding one another at different depths as a strong wind scatters them.
One oversized plain black chess king stands motionless in the center of an empty white surface. The camera is locked, the piece has smooth undecorated sides, and nothing else appears in the frame.

A fixed overhead camera shows a carved wooden chessboard mid-game with all pieces in place: intricate knights with fine manes, crenellated rooks, tiny crosses on the kings, and visible wood grain on every square. Everything remains perfectly still.

One oversized plain black chess king slides and spins rapidly back and forth across an empty white surface, wobbling and changing direction quickly. The background stays blank and the camera does not move.

Dozens of intricately carved wooden chess pieces scatter and tumble rapidly across a detailed chessboard after the table is struck, knights, rooks, and pawns colliding and occluding one another while fine wood grain stays visible. Locked camera.

A single large clear glass marble rests motionless on a smooth empty white surface. The locked camera shows its simple round shape and soft reflection, with no swirls inside and no other objects nearby.

A locked macro camera shows a dense tray of hundreds of small glass marbles, each with intricate colored swirls, tiny bubbles, and sharp highlights, packed tightly together. Every marble stays perfectly still under constant light.
One large clear glass marble rolls very fast across an empty white surface, bouncing off unseen edges and reversing direction repeatedly. The background is uniform and the camera stays locked.

Hundreds of small swirled glass marbles pour and bounce rapidly down a wooden ramp in front of a fixed camera, colliding, ricocheting, and occluding one another while their colored internal swirls and highlights flash past.

One large smooth orange maple leaf lies flat and motionless on a plain gray concrete floor. The camera is locked, the leaf has broad simple color without visible veins, and the empty background never changes.

A locked camera looks down at a forest floor densely covered with hundreds of fallen leaves showing fine veins, tiny holes, frost crystals, pine needles, and small acorns. Every element is crisp and completely still.
One large smooth orange maple leaf is blown violently across a plain gray concrete floor, flipping and skidding quickly from side to side. Nothing else is in the frame and the camera does not move.

A sudden gust whips hundreds of veined autumn leaves, pine needles, and small twigs into a fast swirling vortex above the forest floor. The detailed leaves spin at different depths, repeatedly occluding each other. Fixed camera.
A single large plain red wooden cube sits motionless on an empty white floor. The camera is locked, the cube has flat unpainted faces, and the even lighting and blank background stay constant.

A fixed camera frames an elaborate miniature tower built from hundreds of tiny wooden blocks with visible grain, small painted windows, thin arches, and precise joints. The whole structure is perfectly still and sharply detailed.
One large plain red wooden cube tumbles end over end very quickly across an empty white floor, bouncing and changing direction. The background stays blank and the camera remains locked.

An elaborate tower of hundreds of tiny grained wooden blocks collapses rapidly in front of a fixed camera, blocks with small painted windows and thin arches tumbling, bouncing, and occluding one another as they scatter.
A single large plain white windmill with four broad blank sails stands motionless against an empty pale blue sky. There is no wind, the sails do not turn, and the camera is locked.

A locked wide shot shows a dense valley of dozens of small traditional windmills with lattice sails, tiny shingles, wooden railings, and fields of fine tulips in rows. There is no wind and every detail stays still.
One large plain white windmill spins its four broad blank sails extremely fast in a storm against an empty pale sky. The sails sweep large distances each moment, and the camera is fixed.

Dozens of small traditional windmills with lattice sails spin rapidly in a strong wind across a detailed valley, while rows of tulips whip back and forth and the fine sails overlap and occlude one another. Fixed camera.
A single large smooth golden wax block rests motionless on an empty beige table. The locked camera shows broad plain surfaces with no cells, no bees, and no change in lighting.

A locked macro camera shows a honeycomb frame with thousands of precise hexagonal cells, glistening honey, capped wax, and dozens of motionless bees with fine hairs and veined translucent wings. Nothing moves.
A single large smooth golden wax ball rolls rapidly back and forth across an empty beige table, changing direction sharply. The background is plain and the camera does not move.

Hundreds of bees swarm rapidly over a detailed honeycomb in front of a fixed macro camera, their veined wings blurring as they dart across hexagonal cells and glistening honey, constantly crossing and occluding one another.
One large plain red hot air balloon hangs motionless in an empty pale sky. The envelope has a smooth uniform color without stripes, the basket is simple, and the locked camera shows no drift.

A locked wide shot shows dozens of hot air balloons with intricate patchwork patterns, thin ropes, wicker baskets, and tiny figures, parked above a field of fine grass. All balloons are tethered and completely still.
One large plain red hot air balloon is pushed rapidly across an empty pale sky by a strong wind, swinging and swaying quickly from one side of the frame to the other. Fixed camera.

Dozens of intricately patterned hot air balloons race upward and sideways in gusty wind, crossing paths, overlapping, and occluding one another, with thin ropes and wicker baskets swinging rapidly. Locked camera.
A single large plain white drum sits motionless on an empty dark stage. The locked camera shows its smooth undecorated shell and blank drumhead, with no performer and no lighting change.

A fixed camera shows a complete drum kit with chrome lugs, tension rods, engraved cymbals with fine concentric grooves, coiled cables, and small screws. No one plays and every part remains perfectly still.
A single large plain white drum bounces and rolls rapidly across an empty dark stage, wobbling and changing direction. Nothing else is present and the camera stays locked.

A drummer plays an intense fast solo on a detailed drum kit, sticks blurring between engraved cymbals and chrome hardware, cymbals shaking violently while arms and sticks repeatedly occlude the fine grooves and screws. Fixed camera.
One large plain green wooden spinning top lies motionless on its side on an empty white table. The locked camera shows its smooth unpainted shape and nothing else in the frame.

A locked camera shows a collector's table covered with dozens of small antique spinning tops, each painted with fine stripes, tiny dots, and engraved metal tips, arranged in neat rows. All of them stand completely still.
One large plain green spinning top spins extremely fast and wanders erratically across an empty white table, wobbling and sliding quickly. The background is blank and the camera does not move.

Dozens of finely painted spinning tops spin rapidly and collide on a crowded table in front of a fixed camera, ricocheting apart, wobbling, and crossing paths while their tiny stripes and dots blur and occlude one another.
A single large plain white carousel horse stands motionless on a pole against an empty gray background. The camera is locked and the horse has smooth undecorated surfaces with no ornament.

A fixed camera shows a stationary antique carousel crowded with carved horses featuring gilded manes, tiny mirrors, painted flowers, brass poles, and hundreds of small light bulbs. Nothing turns and every detail is crisp.
A single large plain white carousel horse moves rapidly up and down and swings across the frame against an empty gray background as if on a fast ride. The camera stays fixed.

An ornate carousel spins very fast in front of a fixed camera, carved horses with gilded manes rising and falling while brass poles, mirrors, and hundreds of small lights sweep past and occlude one another.
A single large plain silver ball rests motionless on an empty flat black surface. The locked camera shows its smooth reflective shape, with no markings and nothing else around it.

A locked overhead camera shows the playfield of a vintage pinball machine with intricate illustrated artwork, tiny bumpers, thin metal rails, small star rollovers, and dense rows of inserts. The machine is off and nothing moves.
One large plain silver ball shoots very fast across an empty flat black surface, ricocheting off invisible walls and reversing direction repeatedly. The camera is locked and the background is blank.

Several silver balls ricochet rapidly around a detailed vintage pinball playfield, flippers snapping, bumpers flashing, and balls crossing over illustrated artwork, thin rails, and small inserts. Fixed overhead camera.
One large plain yellow diamond kite hangs motionless against an empty white sky. The kite has no pattern or tail decorations, there is no wind, and the camera is locked.

A locked camera shows dozens of handmade kites laid out on a lawn, each with intricate painted dragons, fine bamboo frames, thin strings, and ribbon tails with tiny tassels. Everything lies completely still.
One large plain yellow diamond kite darts and loops rapidly across an empty white sky in strong wind, swooping from corner to corner. Fixed camera, no other objects.

Dozens of intricately painted kites with long ribbon tails dive and loop rapidly across a crowded sky, tangling strings, crossing paths, and occluding one another while fine bamboo frames flex. Locked camera.
A single plain matte blue bicycle wheel rim leans motionless against an empty white wall. The locked camera shows broad simple surfaces with no spokes, no tools, and no other objects.

A fixed camera shows a cluttered bicycle workshop wall with dozens of hanging wheels with thin spokes, chains with tiny links, gears, cables, wrenches, and small screws. Everything is crisp and completely still.
A single plain matte blue wheel rim rolls quickly back and forth across an empty white floor, wobbling and changing direction. The background is blank and the camera does not move.

In a cluttered workshop, a bicycle on a stand has its wheel spun very fast while the chain races over gears; thin spokes blur, tiny chain links whirl, and hanging tools sway in front of a fixed camera.
One large plain white paper lantern hangs motionless against an empty dark background. The locked camera shows its smooth undecorated surface and steady soft glow, with no other objects.

A locked camera shows a night market ceiling strung with hundreds of small paper lanterns painted with fine calligraphy-like brush patterns, thin bamboo ribs, tassels, and wires. All lanterns hang completely still.
One large plain white paper lantern swings violently back and forth across an empty dark background in a strong wind, covering large distances each moment. Fixed camera.

Hundreds of small painted paper lanterns sway and spin rapidly in a gusting wind across a night market ceiling, tassels whipping, bamboo ribs flexing, and lanterns crossing and occluding one another. Locked camera.
A single large plain gray hardcover book lies closed and motionless on an empty white desk. The cover has no title or texture, the camera is locked, and nothing else is present.

A fixed camera shows towering library shelves packed with hundreds of old books with gilded spines, cracked leather, tiny embossed ornaments represented as abstract patterns without readable text, and brass ladder rails. Everything is still.
A single large plain gray hardcover book slides and flips rapidly across an empty white desk, spinning and changing direction quickly. The background is blank and the camera stays fixed.

Hundreds of old books with gilded spines tumble rapidly off tall library shelves, pages fluttering open, books colliding and occluding one another as they fall past brass rails and ornate wood carvings. Fixed camera.
